title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: which Statement Cycle a replenishment transfer is sized on
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when the owner of a Savings & Money Market Accounts account asks for a monthly automatic transfer that puts back what overdraft protection took from the savings account in a Statement Cycle. It fixes that Statement Cycle, and when no amount is worked out.

## Policy clause

1. The Statement Cycle is the one of the most recent overdraft protection transfer, that is the most recent withdrawal on this account posted as an overdraft protection transfer.
2. That transfer is taken only when its counterparty is a checking account of the same customer. When that counterparty is not one of the customer's checking accounts, no amount is worked out under this rule.
3. When overdraft protection transfers to different accounts posted on that most recent date, the records do not show which of them is the most recent, and no amount is worked out under this rule.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** The transfers, their counterparty, posted dates and Statement Cycle are read from the savings account's transaction record; whether the counterparty is one of the customer's checking accounts is read from the bank's checking records.
- **Object correlation.** Only the most recent overdraft protection transfer on this savings account decides the Statement Cycle.

## Input, judgement, output

| Step | What is looked at | What is taken |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | the savings withdrawals posted as overdraft protection transfers | the most recent posted date |
| 2 | the transfers posted on that date | continue only if they all went to the same account |
| 3 | that transfer's counterparty | continue only if it is a checking account of the same customer |
| 4 | that transfer's Statement Cycle | the Statement Cycle the monthly amount is worked out from |

## Worked cases (hypothetical dates)

- **Ordinary case.** Overdraft protection transfers to the customer's checking account posted on 17 May (Statement Cycle May) and 2 June (Statement Cycle June). The Statement Cycle used is June. A mobile app transfer to the same checking account on 5 June is not an overdraft protection transfer and plays no part.
- **Two accounts on the same day.** On 2 June, the most recent date, one overdraft protection transfer covered the customer's first checking account and another covered a second checking account. The records do not show which was the most recent, so no amount is worked out under this rule.

## Points of judgement

**The most recent overdraft protection transfer went to an account that is not one of the customer's checking accounts. Is an amount worked out?** No; no amount is worked out under this rule.
